title: The Head That Ate the Tail
shortTitle: The Head That Ate the Tail
subtitle: One character too many.
description: A filename extension stripper that leaves the dot behind.
instructions: Reproduce the failure mentally or locally.
Pinpoint the exact line and mechanism of the bug.
Write the minimal fix that restores the expected behaviour.
constraints: Do not redesign the function unless the bug requires it.
hints: Write out the indices of "report.pdf" and mark where the dot sits.
Is `slice`’s second argument inclusive or exclusive?

solution.summary: `slice(0, end)` excludes the index `end`. Using `dot + 1` as the end keeps the character AT `dot` — the dot itself. The second argument is an exclusive bound, not a length.
approach: `lastIndexOf` returns the index OF the dot (0-based).
Adding 1 re-includes the dot — a textbook inclusive/exclusive mix-up.

code.label: Corrected implementation

commonMistakes: Not handling the `-1` no-dot case, which this code luckily gets right.

learningObjectives: Trace boundary arithmetic on concrete indices
